candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: All text correct. Title marked as a heading and the four-line English subtitle keeps its line breaks as in the image. Only nits: the title is on one line rather than two, and the space in 山本 真知子 is missing.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: All text correct. Line breaks follow the image closely: 新 on its own, title split as 中級から上級への / 日本語, English subtitle on four lines. No heading markup for the title; space in 山本 真知子 missing.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe every character correctly and invent nothing, so the ranking rests on formatting alone. D is best because it combines a title heading with the original line breaks of the English subtitle. E follows the image's line layout most closely but has no heading, and A has the heading and the 山本 真知子 space but merges the subtitle lines; I put E just ahead for layout fidelity. B and C are identical, with neither heading nor line breaks, so they come last and their order is arbitrary.
